

## Token

  * A Token is a string generated by the server after successful login.قيمة
   بنعملها بعد ما ال user يعمل login بنجاح 
   * It is used to identify the user.
  * It proves that the user is authenticated.
  * It allows the user to access protected resources.

## Bearer Token
A Bearer Token is a way to send the token in an HTTP request using the Authorization Header.
دا نوع من ال token في ال HTTP Request

## Authentication
 is the process of verifying the identity of a user to make sure they are who they claim to be.
 عملية التأكد من هوية المستخدم، وإنه فعلًا صاحب الحساب اللي بيحاول يدخل عليه
